scope: Read-only visualization probe; no training, endpoint evaluation, or queue mutation.

setup.selection_rule: nearest distinct 25th, 50th, and 75th percentiles of per-image 1-cos(angular-force, raw-force)
setup.force: negative KD feature gradient; each force is projected to its own angular/raw plane and unit-normalized

limitations: The three examples are fixed quantiles from one pair/seed, not independent seeds or accuracy-selected examples.
Unit normalization intentionally removes force magnitude; the panel visualizes directions only.
Every example has its own local force plane, so arrows are comparable within a card but do not embed images in a common feature space.
